_comment: INV 3 RELAXATION — FROM-SCRATCH build (no basedOnCanonical, no --canonical-dump), so provenance plays no part. PROVES a TEXT whose LIVE font is the SAP kit font '72' at a known role size is accepted without an explicit [typo:role] tag: it is already SAP-styled, which is exactly what the tag exists to request. Sizes cover the registry: 20 heading · 16 title · 14 body/label · 13 tableHeader · 12 caption · 28 kpi, plus 21 (within the ±1 tolerance of 20). Expected: exit 0.
21px is heading(20) within the documented ±1 tolerance — same rule the tagged path uses.
name: Heading Off By One

_comment: A plainly-named text at a role size — the ordinary delivered-frame case this relaxation exists for. A [typo:role]-TAGGED name is deliberately NOT tested here: tags are stripped at Bind, so on a delivered (post-bind) frame INV 8 correctly rejects a surviving tag. The tagged path is covered by the --pre-bind fixtures.
